apps.title: Black Android
apps.modInfo:
Unofficial BLACK Android port with touchscreen controls.

Installation:
1. Install Black Android launcher APK.
2. Download ISO file.
3. Grant storage access in launcher.
4. Place .iso in /storage/emulated/0/Black or use Import game.
5. Game starts automatically after loading.

apps.title: Skyrim
apps.modInfo:
How to Run 🎮

1. Download the Skyrim APK for Android 📲
2. Prepare the PC version files (Steam 1.9.32.0.8) 💻
3. Make sure these files exist: (TESV.exe, TESV_unpacked.exe, d3dx9_42.dll, binkw32.dll, X3DAudio1_7.dll, and the Data folder) 📂
4. Move them into a folder named Skyrim in your internal storage (outside Android/data) 📁
5. Open the app ➡️ Select the Skyrim folder ➡️ Grant permissions ✅
6. Wait for Ready ⏳
7. For best performance: lower graphics, set resolution to 480p/540p, and disable antialiasing ⚙️
8. Tap Play and enjoy! ⚔️🐉

apps.title: BioShock
apps.modInfo:
Installation Guide:
1. Download and install the BioShock APK.
2. Download the game data archive.
3. Open the app and tap "Allow" to grant All Files Access.
4. Under "Game Files", tap ZIP Archive... (or Folder... if already extracted) and select the game data.
5. Once ready, tap "Play" to start the game.

apps.title: Assassin’s Creed Black Flag
apps.modInfo:
Installation Guide:
1. Download and install the Assassin's Creed Black Flag APK.
2. Download the secondary .romfs file (if its filename ends with .apk, remove .apk) and place it anywhere on your internal storage or SD card.
3. Open the app, tap "Select Game Data...", and choose the .romfs file.
4. Once loaded, the game will start automatically.
